text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Grey dots: a random sample of 1,200 of the 3,575 forecast cases. Orange line: mean of all cases in bins of 4 points of shift. Dashed line: the residual if the shift were exactly right (coefficient 1, slope -1). The orange line is flatter than the dashed one. Five Primary substations, June to August, valid 09:00 to 15:00 UTC, 1 to 4 days ahead, forecasts from experiment 46.'
text.tspan: Grey dots: a random sample of 1,200 of the 3,575 forecast cases. Orange line: mean of all cases in bins
of 4 points of shift. Dashed line: the residual if the shift were exactly right (coefficient 1, slope
-1). The orange line is flatter than the dashed one. Five Primary substations, June to August, valid
09:00 to 15:00 UTC, 1 to 4 days ahead, forecasts from experiment 46.
